info.title: Finance OS API — B0 contracts
info.description: Contract-first v1 API. Except health routes, these operations are RESERVED for B1+ and intentionally not served by B0. No client should assume endpoints are live.

servers.description: Local API process; no financial operations in B0

post.description: Transition a balanced draft journal to immutable POSTED state in one transaction. Server computes posting validity and audit event.

enforcedByProvider.description: Always false until a verified integration is operating.

bearerAuth.bearerFormat: opaque access token; B1 identity provider TBD

amountMinor.description: Signed integer count of minor currency units; negative amounts are permitted only where a domain schema explicitly accepts them.
